item.title: OpenAI Claims Proof That Matrix Multiplication Exponent Equals 9/4
item.description:
After proving ω≤9/4 in October, OpenAI now claims to have established ω≥9/4, closing the gap to conclude that the matrix multiplication exponent equals 9/4. If verified, this would be a landmark result in computational complexity on the asymptotically optimal cost of matrix multiplication, with implications for a range of related complexity questions. Note that ω is asymptotic, and practical performance still depends on constant factors, memory access and hardware.

原文标题：OpenAI 宣称证明矩阵乘法指数恰为 9/4

Why it matters：若证明无误，这是计算复杂性理论级别的重大成果，且由 AI 公司提出，对算法与 AI 基础设施读者高度相关。

item.title: Intel Open Sources One Mono Font for Low-Vision Developers
item.description:

It ships in four weights with matching italics, covers over 200 Latin-script languages, and is distributed as both ready-to-use builds and editable sources.

item.title: Google Mandates MCP Servers for AI Agents Accessing Workspace
item.description:

item.title: HIT-Built Fire Rescue Robot Dog Survives 1,000°C in Live Drill
item.description:
A team led by the Harbin Institute of Technology Suzhou Research Institute, together with the Jiangsu Intelligent Robot Technology Innovation Center and other partners, has built China's first fire-reconnaissance robot dog rated for 1,000°C, completing a live drill with the Suzhou fire brigade on November 25. The key advance is not the robot itself but a composite fireproof fabric derived from Long March 5 thermal-protection materials, enabling 10 minutes of continuous operation at 1,000°C and covering roughly 95% of fire scenarios. Laser gated imaging for smoke penetration and redundant 5G links allow stable high-definition video relay inside high-rise buildings.

原文标题：哈工大耐 1000℃ 消防侦察机器狗完成实战测试

item.title: Terence Tao Shares How to Read Hard Proofs with AI
item.description:
Fields Medalist Terence Tao outlines a methodology for using AI to understand complex mathematical proofs: rather than one-shotting the full proof, ask the AI to strip a general argument down to a simpler one-dimensional case and read that first. He stresses that whiteboard reasoning remains central, with AI best suited to cleanup and to tedious computations whose sign details need not be understood, and notes that knowing when not to use these tools is itself part of the challenge.

原文标题：陶哲轩谈如何用 AI 读懂艰深数学证明

Why it matters：顶级数学家给出可操作的 AI 辅助数学研究工作流，对理解 AI 在形式推理中的真实边界有参考价值。

item.title: Tencent Hunyuan Open-Sources DFly2 Drafter Model with Up to 4.2x Speedup
item.description:
Tencent Hunyuan has open-sourced DFly2, a new drafter model that acts as a sidecar accelerator for Hy4 flash without altering model weights or outputs, delivering up to 4.2x speedup in a single case. Its key design aggressively reuses the target model's KV cache and indexer-selected positions, decoupling attention cost from context length while requiring zero extra KV memory and remaining PD-disaggregation friendly. Weights, full training code and a paper are released together.

item.title: Global PC GPU Shipments Fall 5% Year-on-Year in Q3 2026
item.description:

Intel gained 2.6 percentage points of share while AMD and Nvidia each slipped about 1.3 points; mobile GPUs fell 9.6% QoQ as the main drag, while desktop GPUs rose 13%.

Unlike the Preview version that relied on a VLA model to execute tasks, the official release decides when to invoke the VLA versus directly controlling the arm via code, and adjusts strategies from execution feedback.
